summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Rhisos Mobilya CRM. Backend: 21/21 pytest passed (auth, customers, quotes with totals + approve->auto-income + revert removes income + delete cascades, transactions CRUD/filters, dashboard stats). Frontend: login with seeded admin OK, dashboard renders stats + monthly bar chart + expense pie chart, customer create OK, quote create with 2 items + discount computes grand total correctly (subtotal 2000 + VAT 400 - disc 100 = 2300 TL), approving quote via status select auto-creates income visible in Cash Flow, manual expense add works, income/expense filters work, print/PDF button present on quote view.

issues: Toast notifications appear top-right and can visually overlap the primary action button (e.g. 'Yeni Teklif') for ~2s; consider moving toast position or auto-dismissing faster

critical_code_review_comments: server.py sets auth cookies with samesite='none' + secure=True which requires HTTPS - fine for preview but will break plain http/local dev.

compute_quote_totals applies VAT on pre-discount subtotal even though discount is subtracted from subtotal. This is a business/tax decision - comment in code notes 'keep simple: vat on pre-discount' - flag for confirmation with client.

Login rate limiting stores locked_until on every failed attempt, but the lock only triggers when count>=5; a single successful login clears attempts. Consider only setting locked_until when count reaches 5 to avoid confusion.
Dashboard endpoint loads up to 5000 transactions into memory and aggregates in Python - for scale consider MongoDB aggregation pipeline.
No user-scoping on customers/quotes/transactions - all authenticated users see all data. If multi-tenant intended this is a leak; if single-org, acceptable.
next_quote_number uses count_documents which is racy under concurrency and reuses numbers if a quote is deleted.
seed_data_creation: Test run left a few TEST_/UI_TEST_ customers, quotes (1 approved), and manual expense transactions in the DB. Backend pytest cleans its own created quote+customer; some transactions from filter tests remain and are visible on dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_rhisos_backend.py (pytest, 21 tests, parallel-safe). Auth via httpOnly cookies; requests.Session() handles them. Dashboard route is '/' (not '/dashboard'). Sidebar nav testids: nav-dashboard/nav-customers/nav-quotes/nav-cashflow. Quote status Select uses shadcn Select - open with click then click role='option' text 'Onaylandı'. Toast overlaps 'Yeni Teklif' after saving customer - prefer direct URL navigation to /quotes/new.
